pairs: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jonam, filium Amathi,
And the word of the Lord came to Jonah the son of Amittai,
quia ascendit malitia ejus coram me.
For its malice has ascended before my eyes.
And Jonah rose in order to flee from the face of the Lord to Tarshish.
ut fugeret in Tharsis a facie Domini,
And he went down to Joppa
and found a ship bound for Tarshish.
et invenit navem euntem in Tharsis,
and he went down into it,
et descendit in eam ut iret cum eis in Tharsis a facie Domini.
in order to go with them to Tarshish from the face of the Lord.
Dominus autem misit ventum magnum in mare:
But the Lord sent a great wind into the sea.
et facta est tempestas magna in mari,
And a great tempest took place in the sea,
and the ship was in danger of being crushed.
et clamaverunt viri ad deum suum,
and the men cried out to their god.
et miserunt vasa quæ erant in navi, in mare, ut alleviaretur ab eis;
And they threw the containers that were in the ship into the sea in order to lighten it of them.
et Jonas descendit ad interiora navis,
And Jonah went down into the interior of the ship,
and he fell into a painful deep sleep.
“Why are you weighed down with sleep?
si forte recogitet Deus de nobis,
so perhaps God will be mindful of us
Et dixit vir ad collegam suum:
And a man said to his shipmate,
et sciamus quare hoc malum sit nobis.
so that we may know why this disaster is upon us.”
and the lot fell upon Jonah.
Indica nobis cujus causa malum istud sit nobis:
“Explain to us what is the reason that this disaster is upon us.
vel ex quo populo es tu?
Or which people are you from?”
et Dominum Deum cæli ego timeo,
and I fear the Lord God of heaven,
who made the sea and the dry land.”
And the men were greatly afraid,
cognoverunt enim viri quod a facie Domini fugeret,
(For the men knew that he was fleeing from the face of the Lord,
“What are we to do with you,
so that the sea will cease for us?”
and cast me into the sea,
and the sea will cease for you.
scio enim ego quoniam propter me tempestas hæc grandis venit super vos.
For I know that it is because of me that this great tempest has come upon you.”
Et remigabant viri ut reverterentur ad aridam,
so as to return to dry land,
For the sea flowed and swelled against them.
And they cried out to the Lord,
ne pereamus in anima viri istius,
do not let us perish for this man’s life,
et ne des super nos sanguinem innocentem:
and do not attribute to us innocent blood.
have done just as it pleased you.”
and cast him into the sea.
et stetit mare a fervore suo.
And the sea was stilled from its fury.
Et timuerunt viri timore magno Dominum:
And the men feared the Lord greatly,
and they sacrificed victims to the Lord,
